import json,random,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
rng=random.Random(31337)
seen=set(); fib=[]
while len(fib)<2048:
    net=rng.getrandbits(128)
    if net in seen: continue
    seen.add(net); fib.append((net,128,rng.randrange(65536)))
cuts=[8*i for i in range(1,17)]
req={'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/128','hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':8}
open('maximg_req.json','w').write(json.dumps(req)+'\n')
print('ok', len(cuts))
"
